item.title: Good, but "wrong"
item.content:encoded:
It was really well written, and I upvoted. But there are some major holes in it that almost brake my suspension of disbelief.

1. I don't think the MTF would be so impetuous. It was extremely careless.

2. I don't think the aurors would be so trigger-happy, either. They would play around and seek tactical advantage, if you assume they are competent.

3. Wizards from HP aren't so quick to deal with fast weapons. Mostly their advantage over muggles comes from secrecy. There is no reason for the battle to be so single-sided.

4. As much as Ron can be stubborn, I neither see him being immune to Foundation methods without his wand nor the Foundation resorting to finger-break with a Type Green.

All in all, though, It is so good I want a sequel.
